name: Aqara Smart Lock U100 (EU)

radios.note: Aqara's spec sheet lists Bluetooth 5.0, Zigbee 3.0 and NFC. The lock itself has no Wi-Fi or Thread.

matter.note: No CSA listing for the lock itself was found. Aqara says Matter support goes through a Matter-compatible Aqara hub.

apple_home.note: Aqara advertises Apple Home Key. How the lock reaches Apple Home (Matter bridge or HomeKit through the hub) is not stated clearly in the pages we saw.

google_home.note: Only Aqara's statement that Matter needs a Matter-compatible Aqara hub supports this; no Google-specific page was seen.

alexa.note: Only Aqara's statement that Matter needs a Matter-compatible Aqara hub supports this; no Alexa-specific page was seen.

smartthings.note: Only Aqara's statement that Matter needs a Matter-compatible Aqara hub supports this; no SmartThings-specific page was seen.

home_assistant.note: No Home Assistant docs page for the U100 found. It may be reachable through an Aqara hub's Matter bridge, but that is not confirmed.

hubRequired.note: Aqara says the Aqara Home app works over Bluetooth without a hub. Remote control, remote passcodes and Matter need a Zigbee 3.0 or Matter-compatible Aqara hub.

localControl.note: No Aqara source describes local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Replaces a US-style deadbolt (2 3/8 or 2 3/4 inch backset, 35 to 55 mm door). The pages found are US/global; this does not suit euro-profile cylinders, which is what the U200 is for.

keypad.note: Keypad on the lock, plus a fingerprint reader and NFC for Home Key and cards.

power.note: Four AA batteries, over 8 months at about 8 unlocks a day, per Aqara.

summary: Aqara's Smart Lock U100 is a US-style deadbolt with a keypad, fingerprint reader and NFC for Apple Home Key. It works over Bluetooth without a hub; remote control, remote codes and Matter need an Aqara hub. Four AA batteries power it. We found no EU-specific Aqara page, so EU availability and fit are unconfirmed.
caveats: Aqara's pages for this lock are US or global; no EU product page was found, and EU doors usually take a euro-profile cylinder instead.
Remote control, remote passcodes and Matter need an Aqara Zigbee 3.0 or Matter-compatible hub; Aqara sells the M100 hub in a kit.
Matter and Home Key may not combine fully; one Aqara forum user reported Matter touch-to-unlock not working.
Fits a 2 3/8 or 2 3/4 inch backset and doors 35 to 55 mm thick.
